expectations.text: All method parameters use the 'final' keyword
expectations.evidence: All preHandle and afterCompletion parameters have final: final HttpServletRequest request, final HttpServletResponse response, final Object handler, final Exception ex

expectations.text: MDC.remove() is called in afterCompletion to prevent thread leaks
Semaphore.release() is called in afterCompletion (even on exceptions)
expectations.evidence: RequestLockInterceptor.afterCompletion calls semaphore.release() guarded by StringUtils.isNotBlank(lockKey) and Objects.nonNull(semaphore)

expectations.text: Uses StringUtils.isNotBlank() or StringUtils.isBlank() for header null/empty checks instead of == null
expectations.evidence: TraceIdInterceptor uses StringUtils.isNotBlank(traceId), RequestLockInterceptor uses StringUtils.isNotBlank(lockKey) and Objects.nonNull(semaphore)

expectations.text: Interceptors are registered in a WebMvcConfigurer with addPathPatterns
expectations.evidence: WebMvcConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer, registers both interceptors with .addPathPatterns("/api/**")

expectations.text: Header names and MDC keys are private static final constants, not inline strings
